in_marathi.name: Dishant
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's Will, Divine Order
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dishant हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Dishant is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘dhi’ which means intellect or wisdom and ‘shant’ which means calm or peace. The name signifies the will of God, the divine order, and the peaceful implementation of that will in one's life.
